implementation_boundary: This registry does not merge or change any functional source

wip_policy.snapshot_branches: Immutable recovery archives; not new active tasks

wip_policy.completion_gate: Commit, scoped verification, remote commit check and handoff; otherwise retain explicit WIP

music_integrated_07.validation: Existing 07 records report regression/PnR/board tests; not rerun here

music_engine_safety.validation: Existing records report targeted tests/new PnR; not downloaded

validation.basis: Previously sealed source/evidence; not rerun here

m1_area_work.validation: Mutable area experiments; no acceptance inferred; inspect captured RTL including disabled visualizer

m1_reference.validation: Independent baseline source; results do not sign off modified M1

gui_ca03.validation: Preserved GUI plus RTL edits; no integration acceptance

gui_6e70.validation: Historical GUI/protocol source with subsequent uncommitted changes

hardware_wip.validation: Preserved pointer/evidence; no new native DRC or manufacturing validation
